pattern.name: database_query_optimization
pattern.description: Optimizing database queries for better performance
pattern.when_to_use: When database queries are identified as bottlenecks through profiling or monitoring

implementation.code: -- Before: SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ? -- After: SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE email = ? AND status = 'active'
implementation.explanation: Added specific index on email and status columns for targeted query optimization

pattern.name: caching_strategies
pattern.when_to_use: When implementing or improving caching for frequently accessed data

implementation.explanation: Multi-level caching with user-specific and profile-specific keys, 5-minute TTL, and cache-aside pattern for database queries

pattern.name: connection_pooling
pattern.when_to_use: When applications make frequent database connections or need to scale connection handling

implementation.explanation: Connection pooling reduces connection overhead and prevents connection exhaustion under load. Pool size configured based on application requirements.

pattern.name: async_processing
pattern.description: Implementing non-blocking operations for better throughput
pattern.when_to_use: When synchronous operations are blocking system performance or scalability

implementation.explanation: Asynchronous operations prevent blocking and allow better resource utilization. Use Promise.all() for parallel processing when operations are independent.

pattern.name: lazy_loading
pattern.description: Implementing lazy loading for improved initial page load
pattern.when_to_use: When applications have large datasets or components that aren't needed immediately

implementation.explanation: Lazy loading reduces initial bundle size and improves perceived performance by loading resources only when needed. Code splitting allows for better caching strategies.

pattern.name: load_test_configuration
pattern.when_to_use: When designing load tests to validate system performance under various conditions

implementation.explanation: Comprehensive load test configuration with multiple scenarios, weighted importance, and clear thresholds for automated performance validation.

pattern.name: monitoring_setup
pattern.when_to_use: When setting up monitoring to track system performance and identify issues

implementation.explanation: Multi-layered monitoring approach covering application performance, user experience, and system infrastructure. Custom metrics, histograms, and automated alerting provide comprehensive visibility.

pattern.name: application_profiling
pattern.description: Profiling application code to identify performance bottlenecks
pattern.when_to_use: When investigating performance issues or optimizing critical code paths

implementation.explanation: Multiple profiling techniques for different environments and use cases. Built-in profilers for production, browser tools for development, and memory profiling for leak detection.
